cascade_principles: Each Cabinet member: 30-day focus = get appointed, hold first briefing with statutory officer counterpart, identify top 3 risks + top 3 opportunities.
Each Committee chair: agenda for first meeting must include scrutiny of inherited risks + Reform priorities.
Each outside-body appointee: attend induction, build officer relationships, report financial-exposure decisions back to Cabinet.
Group Whip: enforce motion-submission discipline + coordinate cross-cohort motion replication.
method: Tailored per-portfolio + per-committee playbooks pulled from a shared template library, with council-specific data (audit opinion, DSG status, savings opportunities, supplier red-flags) woven in. New (May-2026 cohort) councils get this fuller cascade pack; established (May-2025 cohort) councils don't need this layer since their team is settled.
